description: pi 1.5.2 in -p mode with cetra's extension: one read of hello.txt, then the answer; traces with prompts.
notes: The extension (crates/cli/src/agents/pi_extension.ts) writes the trace from pi's events, so the scope cetra-pi is the extension's and no pi library produces spans. The provider is pi's openai entry, pointed at the mock with the mock key. The system prompt is empty in the input: pi keeps it outside the messages (D-IN-28 item 4). gen_ai.conversation.id is pi's session id, which differs between runs, so it is volatile. The tool-call id is the mock's and stable. The check passes with no timing attributes.
